policies.text: A model is chosen for showcase catalog listing provided it secures EcoTransport Rebate clearance and achieves a customer safety score of 85 points or above.
A lighting fixture satisfies Energy Star benchmarks when its operating efficiency equals or exceeds 80 lm/W.
A device receives Green Choice Certification if its recycled material content reaches at least 40 percent.
An appliance is granted Priority Logistics Status provided its unit shipping weight remains under 12 kg.
An item achieves EcoTransport Rebate clearance either by featuring an electric motor power of at least 250 W alongside a battery warranty of 3 years or greater, or by maintaining an EU EcoCert Badge.
